adjudication.family_description: Money flows both ways with the same party and reference: a supplier refund beside the payment of its bill; a customer refund beside the customer's payment.
adjudication.error_mode: counterparty direction: a refund quoting the bill is the wrong direction for the bill; only the correctly directed line can settle it
adjudication.label_reason: The customer pays the sales invoice by Faster Payment quoting it; the same week the company refunds the customer £200.00 quoting the same invoice (an agreed goodwill credit): the money-out line is the wrong direction for a sales invoice and the money-in line settles it.
adjudication.terminal_reason: The customer pays the sales invoice by Faster Payment quoting it; the same week the company refunds the customer £200.00 quoting the same invoice (an agreed goodwill credit): the money-out line is the wrong direction for a sales invoice and the money-in line settles it.
adjudication.positive_evidence: A current scoped payment-specific source connecting the transaction and the obligation, supported semantics, valid amounts, and resolved competing allocations.
contradictions: Conflicting remittances or repeated ambiguous references
Another relevant payment with unresolved allocation
